candidates.hook: Lord: "One word from me, and the county gaol will take him before sunrise."
candidates.cliffhanger: Maid (desperate): "What do you want me to say?!" – cut before the Lord answers.
candidates.why: A child’s life is on the line; the viewer is forced to wonder what she’ll be compelled to say.

candidates.hook: Lord: "Did she prepare things no physician had prescribed?"
candidates.cliffhanger: Lord delivers the gaol threat (“One word from me…”) and the clip cuts before the maid can answer.
candidates.why: Shows escalating intimidation and leaves the audience hanging on the maid’s forced confession.

candidates.cliffhanger: Lord pronounces “That is witchcraft.” – cut before the maid’s desperate plea.
candidates.why: The accusation of witchcraft is the series’ central conflict; the cut leaves the verdict hanging.

moments.desc: Lord threatens: "One word from me, and the county gaol will take him before sunrise."
Lord asks: "Did she prepare things no physician had prescribed?"
Maid cries: "What do you want me to say?!" – cut before the Lord’s answer.
